en.p: For the four points $\mathrm{A}(2,\,6)$, $\mathrm{B}(6,\,2)$, $\mathrm{C}(4,\,4)$, $\mathrm{D}(8,\,6)$ in the coordinate plane, let $S$ be the set of all points X satisfying the following conditions.

box: (B) There exists a point P on segment AB such that the two vectors $\overrightarrow{\mathrm{OX}}-\overrightarrow{\mathrm{OP}}$ and $\overrightarrow{\mathrm{OC}}$ are parallel.

en.p: Among the points in the set $S$, let Q be the point with the greatest $y$-coordinate and R the point with the least $y$-coordinate. What is the value of $\overrightarrow{\mathrm{OQ}}\cdot\overrightarrow{\mathrm{OR}}$? (Here O is the origin.) [4 points]
